::: {#thm-slr-deviation-dist}
#### Distribution of the deviations

In a conditional Gaussian model (@def-cond-gaussian),
given the covariates,
the deviations (@def-slr-deviation) are independent and Gaussian
with mean 0 and variance $\varpar_\iobs$:

$$\cdev_\iobs \mid \Predvar_\iobs = \predvar_\iobs \simind \ndist{0, \varpar_\iobs}.$$
:::

::: proof
This is the solution to @exr-slr-deviation-dist.
:::
